protocol:
# R23 long-prefill T4 pilot

Preregistered before first model process: one curated code-review prompt with20 repeated queue handlers, actual GGUF template, thinkingOFF, greedy128-token continuation. Context8192, batch/ubatch512, ncmoe18/t8/tb8/Q8KV/FAon/fitOFF; same frozen9375 build asR22. One stream; no hardware changes. Generate with NO_CALLBACK and verify raw against untouched upstream7fe replay, candidate mmap replay and candidate none replay. Every PP chunk and decode vector must be finite and nonzero; raw bit equality required at identical chunking. On gate failure retain artifacts and do not run speed ranking. This is diagnostic containment, not a quality score.

If gate passes: four independent processes per mode, mmap/none/none/mmap twice, warmup plus three measured repetitions each; no dump/profiling. Same process-level bootstrap50000 seed20261010, margins3%PP/TG and5%p95, one fixed campaign, no adaptive extension, first/last mmap drift>20% invalidates ranking. Time to replay ready is warm-file-cache setup only. RAM/GTT/VRAM2Hz, scope24G/swap2G/floor6GiB/timeout600s; one process at a time. All libraries/hash/env/commands logged, freeze token hash immediately after generation and before replay. Held-out from previous four-prompt routing corpus; teacher-forced replay and semantic answer quality remain separate.
diagnostic_protocol:
# Post-gate diagnostic extension

Declared after R23 candidate mmap failed the raw gate, before these extra processes: repeat the untouched BASE mmap, repeat candidate mmap, and collect candidate none as a diagnostic. Same tokens, chunking, flags, frozen libraries, fresh raw dumps and one warmup. Verify finite/nonzero independently and compare pairwise, chunk by chunk. These runs cannot support speed ranking. A failed B1 repeat is ERRORE_BASELINE for determinism on this workload, not proof of a particular race or a fix. Preserve the original failed planned manifest/CSV/raw/log/maps/telemetry.

corpus.kind: curated synthetic agent-like code review; no semantic quality score
corpus.continuation: 128 greedy tokens, generated without callback, replay token path fixed before timings

analysis.status: ERRORE_BASELINE repeatability on declared long workload; performance gate failed
analysis.limits: Six finite/nonzero dumps; first original vs repeated original differs. Source of nondeterminism not identified. Fork regression or a driver/shader fix cannot be inferred. No quality score or performance ranking.
